note: Two tiers matching the pipeline's two stages. `clause_level_extractions` is what the Extraction Agent should return for ONE clause at a time. `compiled_rule_objects` is what the Rule Compilation Agent produces after merging related clause-level extractions into one obligation. A field set to null means the source clause doesn't specify it — return null, don't guess or omit silently.

clause_level_extractions.obligation: REs shall submit the VAPT report in the format at Annexure-A along with the MD/CEO declaration, to the designated reporting authority.
REs shall plan and complete VAPT activity per the specified periodicity; any unaudited period due to a category change must be included in the current audit cycle.
clause_level_extractions.deadlineRule: VAPT to commence in Q1 of the financial year (for annual-frequency REs)

clause_level_extractions.obligation: REs shall submit the VAPT report, close identified findings, and complete revalidation within the specified timelines after VAPT completion.
clause_level_extractions.deadlineRule: Report: within 1 month of completion (post IT Committee approval). Findings closure: within 3 months of report submission. Revalidation: within 5 months of completion.
clause_level_extractions.evidenceType: VAPT report; closure records; revalidation records

clause_level_extractions.obligation: IT Committee shall track closure of vulnerabilities; open vulnerabilities after 3 months require IT Committee approval and must be closed before the next VAPT exercise; RE shall maintain a risk register.
clause_level_extractions.deadlineRule: Open vulnerabilities closed before next VAPT exercise

clause_level_extractions.obligation: The revalidation report and open observations must be placed before the IT Committee for REs for confirmation and appropriate directions.

REs shall notify SEBI and CERT-In of cybersecurity incidents within 6 hours of detection; report on the SEBI Incident Reporting Portal within 24 hours; Stock Brokers/DPs shall also notify their Exchange/Depository within 6 hours.
clause_level_extractions.deadlineRule: SEBI/CERT-In email notification: 6 hours. SEBI Incident Reporting Portal: 24 hours. Stock Exchange/Depository (for Stock Brokers/DPs): 6 hours.
clause_level_extractions.evidenceType: Incident notification email; SEBI Portal submission record
clause_level_extractions.penalty: Regulatory action possible if the RE fails to report despite being aware of the incident

clause_level_extractions.obligation: Non-adherence to this incident-reporting SOP attracts regulatory action as per extant regulations for REs.
clause_level_extractions.penalty: Regulatory action as per extant SEBI regulations (not further quantified in this clause)

clause_level_extractions.obligation: RE shall report the incident on the SEBI Incident Reporting Portal and via email; also report to CERT-In per their guidelines; CII/protected-system entities additionally report to NCIIPC.
clause_level_extractions.evidenceType: Portal submission; email; CERT-In report; NCIIPC report where applicable

clause_level_extractions.obligation: RE shall submit a schedule of post-incident reports (Interim, Mitigation measures, RCA, VAPT-for-the-incident) within specified timelines from the date of reporting the incident.
clause_level_extractions.triggerCondition: From the date of reporting the incident or being brought to notice about it
clause_level_extractions.deadlineRule: Interim Report: 3 days. Mitigation measures: 7 days. RCA report: 30 days. VAPT for the incident and closure report: 45 days.
clause_level_extractions.evidenceType: Interim report; mitigation report; RCA report; post-incident VAPT closure report

compiled_rule_objects.obligation: REs shall conduct Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) at the specified periodicity, submit the report within the required timeline, and close/revalidate findings on schedule.
compiled_rule_objects.deadlineRule: Report: within 1 month of completion. Findings closure: within 3 months of report submission. Revalidation: within 5 months of completion.

compiled_rule_objects.obligation: REs shall report cybersecurity incidents to SEBI/CERT-In within the mandated timelines and submit the full sequence of post-incident reports.
compiled_rule_objects.deadlineRule: SEBI/CERT-In notification: 6 hours. SEBI Portal: 24 hours. Interim Report: 3 days. Mitigation measures: 7 days. RCA report: 30 days. Post-incident VAPT and closure report: 45 days.
compiled_rule_objects.penalty: Regulatory action as per extant SEBI regulations for non-adherence to the SOP
